span.p:
Suspected HAP / VAP
send cultures, start empiric abx

div.style: color: rgb(230, 221, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MRSA risk?
prior IV abx 90d,
unit MRSA >10-20%

div.style: color: rgb(203, 234, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Add MRSA cover:
Vancomycin OR Linezolid

color: rgb(230, 221, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Dual GNR cover needed?
MDR risk, shock, ARDS,
unit resistance >10%

div.style: color: rgb(203, 234, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TWO agents, different classes:
β-lactam (pip-tazo / cefepime /
meropenem) + FQ or aminoglycoside

div.style: color: rgb(203, 234, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(201, 247, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reassess 48-72h:
de-escalate to culture,
stop MRSA/2nd GNR if negative

div.style: color: rgb(201, 247, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Treat 7 days;
procalcitonin + clinical to stop
